title: Refining invariants of finite groups with class functions
summary: Many numerical invariants of a finite group arise as the multiplicity of the trivial character in a naturally associated class function, and the remaining multiplicities carry finer structural information. For the number of conjugacy classes of elements whose order involves only a chosen set of primes, the natural such class function is a generalized character interpolating between the classical conjugating character and the regular character. We prove that it is a character in two important general cases, obtained independently by Robinson, and we rule out a family of groups and characters…
